title: 13.18. Atītattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Paccuppanno dhammo naatītassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava …pe… upanissaye nava …pe… avigate tīṇi.
